description: Draft. Something an organisation offers the network, published in the open so others can take it up. Only public offers exist as records: an org-os instance's private and matching-only offers never leave it, so this lexicon has no visibility field. Deliberately small, to be co-designed with Weave before it settles.

title.description: A short statement of the offer.

text.description: The offer in full: what it is, who it is for, and how to take it up.

category.description: The area it falls in. The values follow the org-os needs/offers pack (from the network survey).

terms.description: On what terms it is offered, in free text (for example 'free to network members' or 'paid, sliding scale').

status.description: Where the offer stands. open: available. taken: someone took it up and it has no more room. closed: withdrawn.
